application.trace.noOwnConversations: No conversation is linked to this case by reference. You can find your other chats in the assistant's history.
application.trace.originalLanguage: Messages remain in their original language.
application.trace.activityHint: Most recent activity first. Record reads and requests are distinguished from confirmed operations.
application.trace.noEvents: There are no linked events on record.
application.trace.observed: Updated on {{date}}. Source: Nexqori internal records. This read is audited.
application.trace.outcome.refund_approve: The refund was approved and credited
application.trace.next.received: Next action: administration must begin reviewing the customer's account and available records.
application.trace.next.in_review: Next action: check the records and identify any missing information before deciding. The status alone does not confirm a resolution.
application.trace.next.handed_off: Next action: review the context for specialist support. The request is recorded; a specialist assignment is not yet on record.
application.trace.next.refund_pending: Next action: an administrator must review the evidence and approve or reject with a reason. This request has not generated a credit yet.
application.trace.next.refund_approved: The bank recorded the credit in the account holder's account. Review the reason and credit transaction reference; the request keeps its own status.
application.trace.next.refund_rejected: Review the reason recorded by the administrator. This decision did not generate a credit.
application.trace.event.created: The customer confirmed the request. A case reference was created for tracking.
application.trace.event.reviewed: Administration moved the request to under review. This does not confirm a refund or case closure.
application.trace.event.handed_off: A request for human support was recorded against this case. This event does not confirm a specialist assignment.
application.trace.event.refund_requested: The account holder requested a refund review. The balance did not change at this step.
application.trace.event.refund_approved: Administration approved the refund. The credit to the account holder and its transaction were recorded.
application.trace.event.refund_rejected: Administration rejected the refund and recorded a reason. No credit was generated.
application.trace.event.card_blocked: The account holder confirmed blocking this product. This is product activity, not proof of the cause of the request.
application.trace.event.transaction_cont: The assistant read the account holder's transaction and its follow-up to respond. This was a record read.
application.trace.event.tool_transaction: The tool read the account holder's amount, status, transaction and follow-up. This read did not execute financial operations.
application.trace.event.tool_request_sta: The tool read the request status and its refund, if any. It did not change the case.
application.trace.event.conversation_sta: A conversation linked to this context was opened.
application.trace.event.message_sent: The customer sent a message. Open the conversation to read the original content.
application.trace.event.assistant_replie: The assistant saved a response. Response text does not authorize operations.
application.trace.event.conversation_vie: Administration read the conversation. The read and its actor were recorded.
application.trace.event.claim_trace_view: The details of this request were read. The read did not change its status or operations.
application.trace.event.navigation: The assistant proposed opening a screen. Navigation did not execute a banking operation.
application.trace.event.other: The record preserves this activity and its references. It does not include an additional result.
application.trace.event.flow_evaluated: The assistant saved classification, questions and flow progress. Open the conversation to review results and evidence.
application.trace.event.phone_bill_paid: The bill payment was confirmed and the debit and associated transaction were recorded.
application.trace.event.conversation_lin: The conversation was linked to this existing reference; no additional request was created.
claim.eventCreated: The customer confirmed the complaint. A case number was created for tracking.
claim.activityHint: Most recent activity first. Reads and complaints are distinguished from confirmed operations.
error.conversation_closed: Your document is ready. Start a new conversation to continue.
error.profile_required: Complete your profile in Settings first.
chatProfile.review: Confirm the selected value to save it to your profile.
chatProfile.complete: Your profile does not have these details yet. Complete them here and review the information before saving.
claimStage.hint: Confirm each stage. Approving the complaint does not move money; the refund requires a separate confirmation.
claimStage.confirm.delivered: I confirm receipt of this case for handling.
claimStage.confirm.in_review: I confirm that I will review the issue and its evidence.
claimStage.confirm.approved: I reviewed the evidence and approve the complaint. If eligible, I will prepare the refund for a separate confirmation.
claimStage.scope: The refund is credited once to the account holder and appears in Transactions. Pending or declined payments cannot be refunded.
claimStage.approvalRequired: Complete the complaint review and approval in its case file first.
error.claim_approval_required: Approve the complaint before executing the refund.
trace.event.claim_delivered: An administrator confirmed receipt of the case.
trace.event.claim_approved: The review was approved. This does not create a credit; the refund is confirmed separately.
trace.next.claim_delivered: The team received your case and will continue the review.
trace.next.claim_in_review: The team is reviewing the issue and evidence.
trace.next.claim_approved: The review is approved. Any eligible refund will be confirmed separately and appear in Transactions.
inbox.intro: Review the evidence, make a decision and move to the next case.
inbox.chooseHint: Choose a case to read its summary, review evidence and manage the response.
